prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Conroe, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1148; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather keep my name off the recording, if that's okay. You can use the claim file for that.

Q: That works. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was driving through the intersection in Conroe, Texas, heading north on the main road. The light had been green when I got close.

Q: Which direction was the other vehicle coming from?

A: It came from my left, from the cross street. It didn't stop. I saw it at the last second and tried to brake, but it hit the driver's side door.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was. The airbag on my side went off, so I hit my head on the window frame.

Q: Did you lose consciousness at any point?

A: I don't think I fully blacked out, but I was dazed for a while. I remember the paramedics asking me questions I couldn't answer right away.

Q: How are you feeling now?

A: Still getting headaches, and bright lights bother me. The doctor said it's a concussion and told me to limit screen time and rest as much as I can.

Q: Have you been seen by a physician since the accident?

A: Yes, I went to the emergency room that same day and I've had two follow-up visits. I'm waiting on a referral to a neurologist.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I want to make sure the other driver's account gets documented too. I'm sure they'll say the light was theirs.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
